values.name: Reference price
values.description: Reference price Code identifying a reference price.

values.name: Price includes tax
values.description: Price includes tax Code specifying that the price is inclusive of tax.

values.name: Buyer suggested retail price
values.description: Buyer suggested retail price The suggested retail price as suggested or determined by the party purchasing the goods.

values.name: Ocean charges rate
values.description: Ocean charges rate The charges imposed by the ocean transportation industry above and beyond the basic freight.

values.name: Not subject to fluctuation
values.description: Not subject to fluctuation Not subject to escalation or adjustment.

values.name: Subject to escalation
values.description: Subject to escalation Subject to increase or development by successive stages.

values.name: Subject to price adjustment
values.description: Subject to price adjustment Code specifying that the price is subject to adjustment.

values.name: Subject to escalation and price adjustment
values.description: Subject to escalation and price adjustment Subject to increase or development by successive stages and price adjustment.

values.name: Fluctuation conditions not specified
values.description: Fluctuation conditions not specified Code specifying that the fluctuation conditions are not identified.

values.name: All in price
values.description: All in price Firm price for specified work.

values.name: New price
values.description: New price A price valid from an effective date/time/period.

values.name: Old price
values.description: Old price A price valid prior to an effective date/time/period of a new price.

values.name: Per week
values.description: Per week To indicate that the given price applies per week.

values.name: Price on application
values.description: Price on application Price can be obtained on request from seller.

values.name: Unpacked price
values.description: Unpacked price The price given is the price of the item without packaging.

values.name: Trade price
values.description: Trade price Discount price available to all customers except the retail customer.

values.name: Firm price
values.description: Firm price Price which will remain unchanged for a given time period.

values.name: Material share of item price
values.description: Material share of item price The per unit cost of referenced material based on a given quotation for that material.

values.name: Labour share of item price
values.description: Labour share of item price The labour component of the per-unit item price.

values.name: Transport share of item price
values.description: Transport share of item price The transport component of the per-unit item price.

values.name: Packing share of item price
values.description: Packing share of item price The packing component of the per-unit item price.

values.name: Tooling share of item price
values.description: Tooling share of item price The tooling component of the per-unit item price.

values.name: Temporary vehicle charge
values.description: Temporary vehicle charge The component of a price charged for providing a temporary vehicle.

values.name: Price component due to interest
values.description: Price component due to interest This is the component of the price which is charged due to interest.

values.name: Price component due to management services
values.description: Price component due to management services This is the component of the price which is charged due to management services rendered.

values.name: Price component due to maintenance
values.description: Price component due to maintenance This is the component of the price which is charged due to maintenance.

values.name: Individual buyer price
values.description: Individual buyer price A price which is available to an individual buyer as opposed to an institutional buyer.

values.name: Group buying price
values.description: Group buying price A price which is available to a buying group.

values.name: Group member buying price
values.description: Group member buying price A special price given to a member of a buying group.

values.name: Pre-payment price
values.description: Pre-payment price A special price if pre-payment is made for the article ordered.

values.name: Retail price - excluding taxes
values.description: Retail price - excluding taxes Retail price not including any applicable taxes.

values.name: Suggested retail price - excluding taxes
values.description: Suggested retail price - excluding taxes Suggested retail price not including any applicable taxes.

values.name: Agreed minimum price
values.description: Agreed minimum price The minimum price agreed between trading partners.

values.name: Statutory minimum retail price
values.description: Statutory minimum retail price The legal minimum retail price.

values.name: Cost reimbursement price
values.description: Cost reimbursement price A code to indicate that the price represents the reimbursement of the actual costs incurred.

values.name: Market price
values.description: Market price A code to indicate that the given price is applicable under normal competitive conditions.

values.name: Open tender price
values.description: Open tender price A code to indicate that the price mentioned has been submitted in the context of an open tender.

values.name: Base price
values.description: Base price The base price of a product or service.

values.name: Base price difference
values.description: Base price difference The difference in price against a base price.

values.name: Adjustable price prior to acceptance
values.description: Adjustable price prior to acceptance A price which can be adjusted due to economic conditions between the date of offer and the date of acceptance.

values.name: Revisable price after acceptance
values.description: Revisable price after acceptance A price which can be revised due to economic conditions between the date of acceptance of the order and the date of delivery.

values.name: Provisional ceiling price
values.description: Provisional ceiling price A provisional price which cannot be exceeded.

values.name: Adjustable provisional ceiling price
values.description: Adjustable provisional ceiling price A provisional price which cannot be exceeded but which can be adjusted due to economic conditions between the date of offer and the date of acceptance.

values.name: Revisable provisional ceiling price
values.description: Revisable provisional ceiling price A provisional price which cannot be exceeded but is revisable due to economic conditions between the date of acceptance of the order through to the date of delivery.

values.name: Revisable provisional price
values.description: Revisable provisional price A provisional price which is revisable due to economic conditions between the date of acceptance of the order and the date of delivery.

values.name: Adjustable provisional price
values.description: Adjustable provisional price A provisional price which is adjustable due to economic conditions between the date of offer and the date of acceptance.

values.name: Area price
values.description: Area price Price connected to a geographical area.

values.name: Area system price
values.description: Area system price A basis price applied to a geographic area.

values.name: Special balance regulation price
values.description: Special balance regulation price The price applicable to the power generated as a result of a special balance regulation.

values.name: Balance regulation price
values.description: Balance regulation price The price applicable to the power generated as a result of a balance regulation.

values.name: Upward balance regulation price
values.description: Upward balance regulation price The price applicable to the power generated as a result of an upward balance regulation.

values.name: Downward balance regulation price
values.description: Downward balance regulation price The price applicable to the power generated as a result of a downward balance regulation.

values.name: Active ingredient
values.description: Active ingredient Code specifying that price is based on the active ingredient.

values.name: Alternate price
values.description: Alternate price A substitute cost.

values.name: Advice price
values.description: Advice price Code specifying an advice price.

values.name: Broker price
values.description: Broker price Code specifying a broker price.

values.name: Catalogue price
values.description: Catalogue price Price per unit of quantity of a product as specified in a catalogue.

values.name: Current domestic value
values.description: Current domestic value The present worth of a thing which comes from one's homeland, in terms of money or goods.

values.name: Contract price
values.description: Contract price Price per unit of quantity of a product/service as agreed in a contract between parties.

values.name: Current price
values.description: Current price Price at time of transaction, but subject to future change.

values.name: Consumer unit
values.description: Consumer unit Code specifying that the price is based on consumer unit.

values.name: Confirmed unit price
values.description: Confirmed unit price The value of a single item that proves to be correct.

values.name: Declared customs unit value
values.description: Declared customs unit value A clearly known duty on a single item which is imposed by law.

values.name: Dealer adjusted price
values.description: Dealer adjusted price The necessary or desirable changes that the sales agency makes with respect to the value of the product.

values.name: Distributor price
values.description: Distributor price The cost associated with the agency that markets goods.

values.name: Discount price
values.description: Discount price A reduction from the usual list value.

values.name: Dealer price
values.description: Dealer price Code specifying a dealer price.

values.name: Discount amount allowed
values.description: Discount amount allowed A certain price up to which one is able to make reductions from the usual list value.

values.name: ECSC price
values.description: ECSC price Price registered at European Commission Steel and Carbon office (DG III).

values.name: Estimated price
values.description: Estimated price Code specifying an estimated price.

values.name: Expected unit price
values.description: Expected unit price The anticipated value of a single item.

values.name: Freight/charge rate
values.description: Freight/charge rate The price that is either a freight rate or a rate on which freight charges are calculated.

values.name: Gross unit price
values.description: Gross unit price Unit price to which allowances and charges apply.

values.name: Invoice price
values.description: Invoice price Price per unit of quantity of a product as specified on an invoice.

values.name: Labelling price
values.description: Labelling price Retail price of the buyer that should be printed by the producer on the article's label. The labelling price is not necessary the effective retail price.

values.name: Maximum order quantity price
values.description: Maximum order quantity price The greatest amount of goods or services which one can buy to receive a certain value.

values.name: Minimum order quantity price
values.description: Minimum order quantity price The least amount of goods or services that one can buy to receive a certain value.

values.name: Minimum release quantity price
values.description: Minimum release quantity price The least amount of an order one can place in order to receive a certain value.

values.name: Manufacturer's suggested retail
values.description: Manufacturer's suggested retail Price that reflects "Sales to other manufacturers" or "Sales for resale".

values.name: Maximum release quantity price
values.description: Maximum release quantity price The greatest amount of an order that one can place in order to receive a certain value.

values.name: Not-to-exceed price
values.description: Not-to-exceed price Code specifying a price that cannot be increased.

values.name: No quote
values.description: No quote No price available.

values.name: Net unit price
values.description: Net unit price Unit price to which no allowances and charges apply.

values.name: Net weight
values.description: Net weight Code specifying a net weight price.

values.name: Ocean freight rate
values.description: Ocean freight rate The price per pricing unit of ocean transportation services for moving cargo from one location to another.

values.name: Price break quantity(s)
values.description: Price break quantity(s) Numerical amounts of goods or services which are associated with different sums of money. As the amount goes up, the price per individual item decreases.

values.name: Unit price beginning quantity
values.description: Unit price beginning quantity The starting amount at which you can place a value on a single item.

values.name: Prepaid freight charges
values.description: Prepaid freight charges The cost of shipping is paid before the goods are shipped.

values.name: Provisional price
values.description: Provisional price Price per unit of quantity of a product as provisionally agreed.

values.name: Producer's price
values.description: Producer's price The value that the maker of a good places on an item.

values.name: Promotional price
values.description: Promotional price The value that is placed on an item that is being developed. The idea is to sell this product for less than one normally would, and make up for it by selling a larger quantity.

values.name: Gross weight
values.description: Gross weight Code specifying a gross weight price.

values.name: Quote price
values.description: Quote price Price per unit of quantity of a product as specified in a quote.

values.name: Resale price
values.description: Resale price Price per unit of quantity of a product to be used for resale.

values.name: Retail price
values.description: Retail price Price per unit of quantity of a product to be used for retail.

values.name: Ship and debit
values.description: Ship and debit To transport goods and be owed money by the customer for the services performed.

values.name: Suggested retail price
values.description: Suggested retail price Price per unit of quantity of a product suggested for retail.

values.name: Gross weight without wooden pallets
values.description: Gross weight without wooden pallets Used in steel industry.

values.name: To be negotiated
values.description: To be negotiated Code specifying that the price has to be negotiated.

values.name: Transfer
values.description: Transfer To carry or remove from one place, situation, or person to another.

values.name: Traded unit
values.description: Traded unit Code specifying a traded unit price.

values.name: Theoretical weight
values.description: Theoretical weight Code specifying a price based on a theoretical weight.

values.name: Wholesale price
values.description: Wholesale price Code specifying a wholesale price.
